name: Founder decision: Adopt or decline "the order is the decision" as an operating tiebreaker
text_content:
The brand deck (p. 04) and the white paper both state that the company protects bandwidth, then joy, then retention, then results. The deck adds a sentence the text canon does not carry: "the order is the decision."

Adopted into the operating charter, that converts a sequence into a rule with real consequences on a real night: covers are reduced rather than the floor thinned, and a service period that consumes the team's bandwidth is restructured before it is defended on results. The white paper's own framing supports the strong reading ("This is mechanical, not aspirational," WP p. 17).

The decision is whether to accept those consequences as a binding tiebreaker or to hold the sequence as a description of how health works.

Brandon, with Dominic. Filed by Session 2. Reasoning is in section 4 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
